tips.label: 問位置
tips.text: Where + be + 地點？回答用「主詞 + be + 位置片語」。

tips.label: 問怎麼去
tips.text: How + do / does / did / can / will + 主詞 + go / get to + 地點？助動詞後用原形動詞。

tips.label: here / there / home
tips.text: 這三個字可直接表示地點，go / get 後不用再加 to：get there、go home。

tips.label: 指路
tips.text: 指路常用原形動詞開頭：Go straight. / Turn left. / Cross the street. 否定用 Don’t + 原形動詞。

tips.label: 交通方式
tips.text: go by bus = take a bus；go by bike = ride a bike。by 後不加 a、the 或所有格；步行用 on foot。

tips.label: 上下車
tips.text: 汽車、計程車用 get in / out of；公車、火車、捷運等用 get on / off。

notes.title: 位置描述與 Where 問句
notes.rule:
Where + is / are + 地點？
主詞 + is / are + 位置片語。
notes.description: 問「在哪裡」用 Where。單數地點配 is，複數配 are；回答時用 be 動詞連接主詞與位置。常見片語：across from（對面）、next to（旁邊）、in front of（前面）、behind / in back of（後面）。
examples: Where is the post office? — It is next to the bank.（郵局在哪裡？——在銀行旁邊。）
Where are the taxis? — They are in front of the hotel.（計程車在哪裡？——在旅館前面。）
The school is across from the church.（學校在教堂對面。）

notes.title: 兩個地點之間與交叉路口
notes.rule:
between A and B
on the corner of A and B
notes.description: between A and B 表示在兩個地點之間，兩端用 and 連接。描述兩條路交會處可用 on the corner of，後面列出兩條路名。指示在哪裡轉彎時，常用 at the corner。
examples: The gym is between a library and a temple.（體育館在圖書館和寺廟之間。）
The coffee shop is on the corner of City Road and First Street.（咖啡店在 City Road 和 First Street 的交叉路口。）
Turn left at the corner.（在轉角左轉。）

notes.title: How 問路與交通方式
notes.rule: How + do / does / did / can / will + 主詞 + go / get to + 地點？
notes.description: How 詢問「怎麼去」，回答可以提供路線或交通方式。現在習慣用 do / does；過去用 did；能力或可行方式可用 can；未來可用 will。助動詞後面的動詞用原形，不能再加 -s 或保留過去式。
examples: How does your brother get to school? — He rides a bike.（你哥哥怎麼上學？——他騎腳踏車。）
How did they go to the museum? — They took a bus.（他們怎麼去博物館的？——搭公車。）
How can I get to the market? — Go straight for two blocks.（我要怎麼到市場？——直走兩個街區。）

notes.title: get to 與地點副詞
notes.rule:
get / go to + 地點名詞
get / go + here / there / home
notes.description: school、the station 等地點名詞前通常需要 to。here、there、home 在此是地點副詞，直接放在 go / get 後面，不加 to。here 的用法要配合說話者所在位置，例如 get here、come here。
examples: How can I get to the station?（我要怎麼到車站？）
How can I get there?（我要怎麼到那裡？）
She goes home by bus.（她搭公車回家。）
How did you get here?（你怎麼來這裡的？）

notes.title: 祈使句指路
notes.rule:
原形動詞 + 其他成分。
Don’t / Do not + 原形動詞。
Let’s + 原形動詞。
notes.description: 指路、請求或提醒常用祈使句，省略主詞 you，直接以原形動詞開頭。Please 後也用原形。Don’t 表示不要做某事；Let’s 表示「我們一起……」。兩個動作用 and 連接時，都維持原形。
examples: Go straight for three blocks.（直走三個街區。）
Please turn left at the traffic lights.（請在紅綠燈處左轉。）
Don’t cross the street now.（現在不要過馬路。）
Let’s take a taxi to the museum.（我們搭計程車去博物館吧。）

notes.title: 直走、沿路走與走過
notes.rule:
go / walk straight for + 距離
walk down / along + 路名
walk past + 地點
notes.description: straight 是副詞，可直接修飾 go / walk。for 可接移動的距離或持續時間。down / along 表示沿著路走；past 表示經過某個地點。block 指街區。
examples: Walk along the street for five minutes.（沿著這條街走五分鐘。）
Walk past the hotel. The bakery is next to it.（走過旅館；麵包店就在它旁邊。）
Drive straight for two blocks.（直開兩個街區。）

notes.title: 轉彎、穿越與左右側
notes.rule:
turn left / right = make a left / right turn
cross + 道路 = go across + 道路
be on the / your left / right
notes.description: turn left / right 中的 turn 是動詞；make a right turn 中的 turn 是名詞，因此有 a。cross 本身是動詞；across 是介系詞，前面需要 go、walk 等動詞。描述位於某人的左右側用 on your left / right。
examples: Make a right turn at the corner.（在轉角右轉。）
Turn right onto Second Street.（右轉進入 Second Street。）
Cross Ocean Street. = Go across Ocean Street.（穿越 Ocean Street。）
The hotel is on your right.（旅館在你的右邊。）

notes.title: by + 交通工具與 on foot
notes.rule:
主詞 + go / get to + 地點 + by + 單數交通工具
步行：on foot
notes.description: by 用來表達交通方式時，交通工具前不加 a、the、my 等限定詞，也不用複數：by bus、by train、by bike、by taxi、by airplane。步行用 on foot，不能類推成 by foot。
examples: She goes to school by bicycle.（她騎腳踏車上學。）
We went to the island by ship.（我們搭船去那座島。）
Ann went to the theater on foot yesterday.（Ann 昨天走路去劇院。）

notes.title: take / ride / drive 的交通句型
notes.rule: 主詞 + take / ride / drive + a / the / 所有格 + 交通工具 + to + 地點
notes.description: take 後可接 bus、taxi、train、plane、ship 等；ride 常接 bike、scooter、motorcycle；drive 表示駕駛。交通工具是動詞受詞時，可數單數名詞通常要有限定詞。捷運常用 take the metro。兩種表達不要混用成 take by bus。drive to + 地點、walk to + 地點也很常用。
examples: David took a bus to the train station.（David 搭公車去火車站。）
Benson usually rides a bike to school.（Benson 通常騎腳踏車上學。）
She goes to work by metro. = She takes the metro to work.（她搭捷運上班。）
We drove to the night market.（我們開車去夜市。）

notes.title: 交通句型中的動詞變化
notes.rule:
習慣：第三人稱單數 + takes / rides / drives
過去：took / rode / drove / walked
can / will / do / does / did 後：原形動詞
notes.description: 改寫交通方式時，要同時保留原句的人稱與時間。went 改寫為 take 的句型時要用 took；does 或 did 出現後，主要動詞恢復原形。現在進行式用 am / is / are + V-ing。
examples: Erica always goes to school by bicycle. = Erica always rides a bicycle to school.（Erica 總是騎腳踏車上學。）
They went to the temple by taxi. = They took a taxi to the temple.（他們搭計程車去寺廟。）
Did your dad drive to work?（你爸爸是開車上班的嗎？）
He will ride his bike tomorrow.（他明天會騎腳踏車。）

notes.title: 上下交通工具
notes.rule:
汽車、計程車：get in / get out of
公車、火車、捷運、船、飛機、腳踏車、機車：get on / get off
notes.description: 選擇上下車的表達時，先看交通工具。小客車與計程車用 get in / out of；公車、捷運等用 get on / off。get 的過去式是 got；在 can、will、should 或祈使句中用原形 get。
examples: Please get in the taxi.（請上計程車。）
We got out of the car in front of the hotel.（我們在旅館前下車。）
Get off the bus at the next stop.（在下一站下公車。）
They got on the train at eight.（他們八點上火車。）

quiz.question: Where ___ the bus stop near the museum?
quiz.hint: the bus stop 是單數地點，Where 問位置時用 be 動詞 is。

quiz.question: A: ___ is the parking space? B: It is behind the hotel.
quiz.hint: 回答 behind the hotel 是位置，因此用 Where 問「在哪裡」。

quiz.question: A: ___ can I get to the zoo? B: Walk along this road and turn left.
quiz.hint: 回答提供沿路走和左轉的路線，應用 How 問「怎麼去」。

quiz.question: How ___ your sister go to work every morning?
quiz.hint: every morning 表示習慣，your sister 是第三人稱單數；主要動詞是 go，因此問句用 does。

quiz.question: How ___ the visitors get to the hotel yesterday?
quiz.hint: yesterday 表示過去；get 是原形，問句以 did + 主詞 + get 表示過去交通方式。

quiz.question: How ___ we get to the library? Is it possible to walk there?
quiz.hint: 詢問可行的前往方式可用 How can we get to...?；be 動詞不能在此直接接原形 get。

quiz.question: Where ___ the two taxis? I cannot see them.
quiz.hint: the two taxis 是複數，問位置用 Where are；do / does 不能在沒有主要動詞的句子中取代 be。

quiz.question: How can I ___ home from this station?
quiz.hint: can 後接原形 get；home 是地點副詞，直接放在 get 後即可。

quiz.question: How ___ your mother get here every day?
quiz.hint: your mother 是第三人稱單數，every day 表習慣；用 does 提問，後面的 get 維持原形。

quiz.question: How did you ___ to the airport last night?
quiz.hint: did 已標示過去，主要動詞必須恢復原形 go，不能再用 went。

quiz.question: We can ___ to the train station on foot.
quiz.hint: can 後用原形 go；on foot 表示步行，不會改變動詞形式。

quiz.question: A: The new shop is near the park. B: How can we ___ there?
quiz.hint: can 後用原形，there 是地點副詞，get there 中不可多加 to。

quiz.question: After dinner, the visitors will ___ home by taxi.
quiz.hint: will 後接原形 go；home 在此作地點副詞，形成 go home。

quiz.question: Where ___ your father's truck yesterday afternoon?
quiz.hint: yesterday afternoon 是過去時間，truck 是單數；位置問句的 be 動詞用 was。

quiz.question: Where ___ the two bicycles? They are outside right now.
quiz.hint: two bicycles 是複數，回答 They are 和 right now 表示現在，故用 are。

quiz.question: A: Where is the bakery? B: It ___ across from the market.
quiz.hint: It 是單數主詞，across from the market 是位置片語，前面需用 be 動詞 is 連接。

quiz.question: A: Where are the parking spaces? B: They ___ behind the bank.
quiz.hint: They 是複數，描述位置時用 are；do / does 不是此句的連接動詞。

quiz.question: How ___ you and your brother get to the island last weekend?
quiz.hint: last weekend 是過去時間，問交通方式用 How did + 主詞 + get。

quiz.question: A: Do you go to school by bus? B: Yes, I ___.
quiz.hint: 問句使用現在式助動詞 Do，肯定簡答保留 do：Yes, I do.

quiz.question: How does the clerk ___ work every day?
quiz.hint: does 後須接原形 get；work 在 get to work 這個表達中前面保留 to。

quiz.question: Please ___ across the street when the light turns green.
quiz.hint: Please 開頭的祈使句省略主詞 you，以原形 walk 表達指示。

quiz.question: ___ left at the next corner, please.
quiz.hint: 這是請對方左轉的祈使句，以原形 Turn 開頭。

quiz.question: Please ___ a right turn after you pass the library.
quiz.hint: 祈使句用原形 make，a right turn 在句中是它的受詞。

quiz.question: Don't ___ the road now. A truck is coming.
quiz.hint: 否定祈使句是 Don’t + 原形動詞，所以用 cross；後句也說明現在不宜過馬路。

quiz.question: Let's ___ a taxi because your bike is broken.
quiz.hint: Let’s 後接原形動詞 take，表示提議一起搭計程車。

quiz.question: Turn right at the bank and ___ straight for one block.
quiz.hint: and 連接兩個指路動作，前面 Turn 是原形，後面也使用原形 go。

quiz.question: Go past the museum, and you will ___ the hotel on your left.
quiz.hint: 後半句已有 will，後面要接原形 see。

quiz.question: Please ___ along this road until you reach the parking space.
quiz.hint: Please 表請求，祈使句用原形 drive，不用第三人稱或過去式。

quiz.question: Do not ___ your car in front of the gate.
quiz.hint: Do not 後面接原形 park，構成禁止停車的祈使句。

quiz.question: Let's not ___ the street here. There is a crossing near the bank.
quiz.hint: Let’s not 後仍接原形 cross，表示提議不要在此過馬路。

quiz.question: My brother usually ___ his bicycle to the library.
quiz.hint: usually 表示習慣，My brother 是第三人稱單數，ride 要加 -s 成為 rides。

quiz.question: We ___ a taxi to the airport last night.
quiz.hint: last night 表示過去，take a taxi 的 take 要變成 took。

quiz.question: Will your sister ___ her scooter to work tomorrow?
quiz.hint: Will + 主詞 + 原形動詞，故用 ride，不因 your sister 而加 -s。

quiz.question: Dad didn't ___ to the market yesterday because his car was broken.
quiz.hint: didn’t 已表示過去否定，後面的動詞用原形 drive，不能再用 drove。

quiz.question: Does the clerk ___ the metro to work every day?
quiz.hint: Does 後的主要動詞恢復原形 take；第三人稱的變化已由 Does 表達。

quiz.question: The two visitors usually ___ a bus to the museum.
quiz.hint: usually 表現在習慣，The two visitors 是複數主詞，因此用原形 take。

quiz.question: Mia ___ her bike to the park yesterday afternoon.
quiz.hint: yesterday afternoon 是過去時間，ride 的過去式為 rode。

quiz.question: We will ___ to the beach tomorrow morning.
quiz.hint: will 後接原形 drive，tomorrow morning 也提供未來時間。

quiz.question: Look! Mom is ___ her scooter toward the corner.
quiz.hint: Look! 提醒正在發生的動作，is 後接 V-ing，形成 is riding。

quiz.question: The children ___ the metro to the zoo yesterday.
quiz.hint: yesterday 提示過去時間，take the metro 要改成 took the metro。

quiz.question: The visitor will go to the station by ___.
quiz.hint: by 表交通方式時，後面用不加冠詞的單數交通工具 bus。

quiz.question: My favorite way to go to the park is by ___.
quiz.hint: by 表交通方式時，不加 a、my 等限定詞，也不用複數，所以選 bike。

quiz.question: The clerk will take ___ to the hotel after work.
quiz.hint: take 後直接接交通工具作受詞；taxi 是可數單數名詞，需要 a 等限定詞，不能把 by taxi 接在 take 後。

quiz.question: My cousin rides ___ to school every morning.
quiz.hint: rides 後接受詞；單數可數名詞 bicycle 前需要 a，不能混用 by bicycle 的介系詞句型。

quiz.question: We went to the small town by ___ last Sunday.
quiz.hint: by 用來表示交通方式時，train 前不加冠詞，也不使用複數。

quiz.question: The visitor ___ to the museum on foot last Sunday.
quiz.hint: last Sunday 表示過去，go 的過去式是 went；on foot 說明交通方式。

quiz.question: The bus is at the stop. We should ___ it now.
quiz.hint: should 後接原形動詞，所以上公車使用 get on，不用 gets、got 或 getting。

quiz.question: We ___ off the train at the wrong station yesterday.
quiz.hint: yesterday 表示過去，get off 的 get 要變成 got。

quiz.question: Please ___ out of the taxi on this side.
quiz.hint: Please 開頭的祈使句用原形 get；get out of 表示下計程車。

quiz.question: How ___ Amy and her brother go to school every day?
quiz.hint: Amy and her brother 是兩個人，every day 表習慣，問句使用 do；does 用於第三人稱單數。

Get off the bus at the next stop.

grammar.sentence: The bookstore is across from the train station.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 書店在火車站對面。

grammar.sentence: How can I get to the night market?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我要怎麼到夜市？

grammar.sentence: Please turn left at the next corner.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 請在下一個轉角左轉。

grammar.sentence: My sister usually goes to work by scooter.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我姊姊通常騎機車上班。

grammar.sentence: The bus stop is in front of the bank.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 公車站在銀行前面。

grammar.sentence: We took the metro to the museum yesterday.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們昨天搭捷運去博物館。

grammar.sentence: Walk straight for two blocks and turn right.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 直走兩個街區，再右轉。

grammar.sentence: How did the visitors get to the hotel?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那些遊客怎麼到旅館的？

grammar.sentence: The shop is between the bank and the library.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 商店在銀行和圖書館之間。

grammar.sentence: Please get off the bus at the next stop.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 請在下一站下公車。

grammar.sentence: My dad drove to the market this morning.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我爸爸今天早上開車去市場。

grammar.sentence: Go across the street at the traffic lights.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 在紅綠燈處穿越馬路。

grammar.sentence: Where is the parking space near the hospital?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 醫院附近的停車位在哪裡？

grammar.sentence: The clerk walks to work every morning.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那位店員每天早上走路上班。

grammar.sentence: Turn right and the hotel is on your left.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 右轉後，旅館就在你的左邊。

grammar.sentence: Can we get there by bus before noon?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們能在中午之前搭公車到那裡嗎？

grammar.sentence: The bike is behind the small coffee shop.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 腳踏車在那間小咖啡店後面。

grammar.sentence: Do not cross the street in front of that truck.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 不要在那輛卡車前面過馬路。

grammar.sentence: She rode her bicycle to the park yesterday.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 她昨天騎腳踏車去公園。

grammar.sentence: How does your favorite teacher go home?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你最喜歡的老師怎麼回家？

grammar.sentence: Make a right turn at the next corner.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 在下一個轉角右轉。

grammar.sentence: We will go to the island by ship.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們會搭船去那座島。

grammar.sentence: The bank is on the corner of these streets.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 銀行在這幾條街的交叉路口。

grammar.sentence: Please get in the taxi near the gate.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 請上大門附近的那輛計程車。

grammar.sentence: Walk along this road and go past the museum.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 沿著這條路走，再走過博物館。

grammar.sentence: They went to the station on foot yesterday.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 他們昨天走路去車站。

grammar.sentence: Where are the bicycles outside the store?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 商店外的腳踏車在哪裡？

grammar.sentence: We got out of the car near the library.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們在圖書館附近下車。

grammar.sentence: Let's take a bus because my bike is broken.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我的腳踏車壞了，我們搭公車吧。

grammar.sentence: How will your family get to the airport tomorrow?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你的家人明天會怎麼去機場？

cloze_quiz.question: The ___ flew above the clouds with two hundred people inside.
cloze_quiz.hint: flew above the clouds 表示飛到雲層上方，能載很多人的交通工具是 airplane（飛機）。

cloze_quiz.question: My ___ has two wheels and pedals, but no engine.
cloze_quiz.hint: two wheels、pedals 和 no engine 指有兩輪與踏板、沒有引擎的腳踏車。

cloze_quiz.question: A ___ is a large road vehicle used to carry heavy things.
cloze_quiz.hint: large road vehicle 與 carry heavy things 表示運載重物的大型道路車輛，即 truck（卡車）。

cloze_quiz.question: Mom put on her helmet and rode her small ___ to the market.
cloze_quiz.hint: helmet、rode 和 small 提示媽媽騎的是小型機車 scooter。

cloze_quiz.question: His new ___ has two wheels and a powerful engine. He must wear a helmet when he rides it.
cloze_quiz.hint: 兩輪、強力引擎，以及騎乘時要戴安全帽，指 motorcycle（重型機車）。

cloze_quiz.question: We paid the ___ driver after he took our family to the hotel in his yellow car.
cloze_quiz.hint: 付費請司機用黃色汽車載一家人到旅館，指搭 taxi（計程車）。

cloze_quiz.question: The large ___ sailed across the ocean with many passengers.
cloze_quiz.hint: sailed across the ocean 表示航行過海，符合 ship（船）。

cloze_quiz.question: On a compass, ___ is the direction opposite south.
cloze_quiz.hint: 指南針上與 south（南方）相反的方向是 north（北方）。

cloze_quiz.question: The sun goes down in the ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 太陽從西方落下，west 表示西方。

cloze_quiz.question: On a compass, ___ is the direction opposite north.
cloze_quiz.hint: 與 north（北方）相反的方向是 south（南方）。

cloze_quiz.question: We watched the sun come up in the ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 太陽從東方升起，east 表示東方。

cloze_quiz.question: Dad ___ the car himself all the way to Tainan yesterday.
cloze_quiz.hint: 駕駛汽車用 drive；yesterday 表過去，因此用 drove。

cloze_quiz.question: Yesterday, Leo ___ his bike along the river.
cloze_quiz.hint: 騎腳踏車用 ride，過去式是 rode；drove 指開車，rowed 指划船。

cloze_quiz.question: We used two oars to ___ the little boat across the lake.
cloze_quiz.hint: oars 是船槳；使用船槳划小船要用 row。

cloze_quiz.question: ___, sir. Could you tell me where the nearest bank is?
cloze_quiz.hint: 向陌生人問路前先禮貌地打擾對方，使用 Excuse me。

cloze_quiz.question: The clerk said to the man, "Good morning, ___. How can I help you?"
cloze_quiz.hint: 對成年男性顧客的禮貌稱呼是 sir（先生）；madam 用來稱呼女性。

cloze_quiz.question: You are facing north. To face west at the corner, you should ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 面向北方時，左邊是西方，因此要 turn left（左轉）。

cloze_quiz.question: Wait at the ___ where these two streets meet.
cloze_quiz.hint: 兩條街交會的轉角處是 corner。

cloze_quiz.question: Do not turn left or right. Keep going ___ ahead.
cloze_quiz.hint: 不要左轉或右轉、繼續往前，意思是 straight ahead（一直向前）。

cloze_quiz.question: One ___ is the distance along a street from one corner to the next.
cloze_quiz.hint: 沿街從一個轉角到下一個轉角的距離是一個 block（街區）。

cloze_quiz.question: The bank is directly ___ the school: they face each other on opposite sides of the road.
cloze_quiz.hint: face each other 與 opposite sides of the road 表示隔著路面對面，使用 across from。

cloze_quiz.question: The word is at the ___ of the page, below all the other words.
cloze_quiz.hint: below all the other words 表示在所有文字下方，也就是頁面底部 bottom。

cloze_quiz.question: Our class has one important ___: no eating during lessons.
cloze_quiz.hint: no eating during lessons 是班級規定，rule 表示規則。

cloze_quiz.question: The bicycle wheel is bent, so the bike is ___ and I cannot ride it.
cloze_quiz.hint: 車輪彎曲而不能騎，表示腳踏車壞掉了，使用 broken。

cloze_quiz.question: At their first meeting, the two men smile and politely ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 初次見面微笑並有禮貌地打招呼，符合 shake hands（握手）。

cloze_quiz.question: Of all the restaurants, I like this one the most. It is my ___ restaurant.
cloze_quiz.hint: like this one the most 表示最喜歡，所以選 favorite（最喜愛的）。

cloze_quiz.question: Dad keeps his coins in the ___ of his jeans.
cloze_quiz.hint: 牛仔褲上可裝零錢的口袋是 pocket。

cloze_quiz.question: A scary ___ with three heads appeared in the story.
cloze_quiz.hint: 故事裡出現可怕的三頭怪物，使用 monster。

cloze_quiz.question: The store ___ helped me pay for the beef at the checkout.
cloze_quiz.hint: 在商店結帳處協助顧客付款的人是 clerk（店員）。

cloze_quiz.question: The metro station is beside our house, so taking the metro is very ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 車站就在家旁邊，搭車很方便，因此選 convenient。

cloze_quiz.question: I wrote the wrong address on the letter. I made a ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 寫錯地址就是犯錯；make a mistake 表示犯錯。

cloze_quiz.question: Dad found an empty ___ and left his car inside its white lines.
cloze_quiz.hint: 能把汽車停進白線框內的空位是 parking space（停車位）。

cloze_quiz.question: A person who comes to see a place as a guest is a ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 來參觀或拜訪某個地方的人稱為 visitor（遊客；訪客）。

cloze_quiz.question: This ticket costs only ten dollars, much less than the others. It is ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 票價比其他票低很多，表示 cheap（便宜的）。

cloze_quiz.question: The meat from cattle is called ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: cattle 指牛；牛肉是 beef，pork 是豬肉，chicken 是雞肉。
